description.it: Crea un comando :Trim che rimuove spazi trailing.
description.en: Create a :Trim command that removes trailing spaces.

steps: Testa su file con trailing spaces
exercises.solution:
vim.api.nvim_create_user_command('Trim', function()
  local save = vim.fn.getpos('.')
  vim.cmd [[keeppatterns %s/\s\+$//e]]
  vim.fn.setpos('.', save)
end, { desc = 'Remove trailing whitespace' })

description.it: Configura undo persistente con directory dedicata.
description.en: Configure persistent undo with dedicated directory.

exercises.solution:
local undodir = vim.fn.stdpath('data') .. '/undo'
if vim.fn.isdir(undodir) == 0 then
  vim.fn.mkdir(undodir, 'p')
end
vim.opt.undodir = undodir
vim.opt.undofile = true
vim.opt.undolevels = 1000
